omar-eng: ran into a weird onboarding failure in samplekit: function-call outputs validated fine initially, but after an auth retry the helper reconstructed without jsonMode and returned a raw string -> downstream fncall parser blew up.

liz-docs: ouch. minimal repro?

omar-eng: yep, local flow: initial call -> 401 -> SDK retry wrapper instantiates helperFactory() again. helperFactory reads process.env.DEFAULT_JSON_MODE and ends up returning jsonMode:false. snippet:
```js
const client = new SDK({ jsonMode: true, schema: profileSchema, strictSchema: true, helperFactory: makeHelper });
await client.callTool('getProfile', payload); // on 401 retry: helper = makeHelper() -> reads env -> jsonMode:false
```

sophie-ux: customer hit this yesterday; their onboarding UI expected a structured object but got a single JSON-encoded string. UX confusion and parsing errors.

liz-docs: short-term mitigation: patch RetryWrapper to capture original helper opts (jsonMode, strictSchema, schema) and pass them into retries. Also add a samplekit CI check that simulates an auth 401 and asserts final tool output still matches schema.

omar-eng: I can open a tiny PR: thread opts into retry closure + unit tests. low-risk.

retry-bot: note: auth-service had transient 401 spike at 2026-02-11T16:20Z causing ~0.2% retries across clients.

sophie-ux: for DX: add a short docs callout under SDK helpers "Avoid factories that derive JSON/strict defaults from env on retry" and a samplekit README note.

liz-docs: agreed. I'll draft the blurb and include a sample code pattern to show safe factory: `makeHelper = (opts) => ({ ...defaultOpts, ...opts })` so callers inject preserved opts.

omar-eng: thanks. Plan: PR with fix + tests + docs; QA will run canary on dedicated tomorrow. :thumbsup:
